title: Turning $1M Into $1B+: A Masterclass From The Indian Warren Buffett
summary: Mohnish is sometimes called the "Indian Warren Buffett" for having turned $1M into over $1B+ through stock investing. In this podcast they talk about how founders can become great investors, how to avoid big mistakes, and lessons learned from Buffett & Munger.
